pages.content:
# A.T.M. Vegan Deli

**The best vegan breakfast sandwich on the planet.** A real NYC deli in Clinton Hill / Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn, where every last thing — the bacon, the egg, the cheese, the pastrami — is made from plants. No fine print. 100% plant-based, always.

## Order

Get A.T.M. delivered: **Uber Eats** (full menu), **Grubhub** (full menu), **DoorDash** (limited menu). Or call ahead for takeout: [646-670-3894](tel:+16466703894). Walk-ins always welcome.

## The Story

A.T.M. Vegan Deli took the classic New York deli — the griddle, the ticket counter, the overstuffed hero — and rebuilt it from scratch with whole-food ingredients, house-made proteins, and a serious amount of technique. It tastes like the deli you grew up on; it just happens to be 100% vegan. Our menu runs on three-letter codes — B.E.C., R.B.N., C.H.P., T.N.A. — a wink at deli shorthand and the old bacon-egg-and-cheese ticket tradition.

## Menu

Everything is 100% plant-based, always. (GF = gluten-free · GFO = gluten-free option available.)

### Sandwiches

- **B.E.C.** — Maple wood smoked mushrooms, tofu over easy, cheddar, yolk sauce on a roll. (GFO)
- **S.E.C.** — House-made seitan, tofu over easy, cheddar, yolk sauce on a roll.
- **H.E.C.** — Smoked yuba, tofu over easy, cheddar, yolk sauce on a roll. (GFO)
- **P.E.C.** — Smoked seitan pastrami, tofu over easy, cheese, yolk sauce on a roll.
- **V.E.G.** — Tofu over easy, cheddar, avocado, tomato, greens, fancy aioli on a roll. (GFO)
- **E.N.C.** — Tofu over easy, cheddar, yolk sauce on a roll. (GFO)
- **B.L.T.** — Smoked mushrooms, tomato, avocado, greens, lemon herb mayo on sourdough or whole wheat. (GFO)
- **R.B.N.** — Smoked seitan pastrami, cheese, sauerkraut, russian dressing on griddled rye.
- **C.H.P.** — Chopped Beyond, cheddar, grilled onions, tomato, pickled peppers, greens, special sauce on a hero. (GFO)
- **P.T.Y.** — Beyond patty, cheese, grilled onions on griddled rye with a side of special sauce.
- **M.L.T.** — TNA salad, cheddar, tomato, Old Bay on griddled sourdough or whole wheat.
- **C.B.N.** — Slow roasted tofu, smoked yuba, cheese, pickles, mojo, mustard on a pressed hero.
- **C.L.B.** — Smoked mushrooms, peppered seitan, tomato, greens, mayo on sourdough or whole wheat.
- **T.N.A.** — TNA salad, tomato, greens, mayo on sourdough or whole wheat. (GFO)
- **E.G.G.** — Tofu salad, tomato, greens, fresh herbs on sourdough or whole wheat. (GFO)

### Salads

- **GREENS** — Mixed greens, shallot vinaigrette. (GF)
- **CAESAR** — Romaine, baby kale, croutons, pepita parm, house caesar dressing. (GF)
- **COBB** — Romaine, mushroom bits, peppered seitan, tofu salad, avocado, tomato, cucumber, red onion, bleu cheese, red wine vinaigrette.

### Shares

- **Loaded Chopped Cheese Fries** — Large order of fries topped with chopped Beyond patty, vegan cheddar, grilled onion, spicy pickled peppers, tomato, special sauce, scallions. (GF)
- **Loaded Reuben Fries** — Large order of fries topped with seitan pastrami, vegan cheese, sauerkraut, russian dressing, scallions.

### Sides

- **French Fries** — Handcut daily. (GF)
- **Tofu Salad** — Eggy tofu, fresh herbs. (GF)
- **TNA Salad** — Tofu, chickpeas, hearts of palm, celery, onion, herbs. (GF)
- **Potato Salad** — With tofu, celery, scallions, herbs. (GF)
- **Macaroni Salad** — Bell pepper, celery, onion, parsley.
- **Bean Salad** — Kidneys, chickpeas, celery, cucumber, onion, herbs, lemon dressing. (GF)
- **Cauliflower Salad** — Capers, parsley, mustard dressing. (GF)
- **Housemade Pickles** — Dill, spicy, or extra spicy. (GF)

## Visit

**525 DeKalb Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11205** — Clinton Hill / Bed-Stuy.

- Monday – Friday: 8:00am – 3:00pm
- Saturday – Sunday: 10:00am – 4:00pm

Phone: [646-670-3894](tel:+16466703894) · Instagram: [@a.t.m.vegandeli](https://instagram.com/a.t.m.vegandeli)
